## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the issue, requirement/use case and observable acceptance criteria.

## Change

Describe the final change and dependencies. For an imported baseline, give its source
repository/commit, actual attribution and what was prepared or changed after the import.

## Verification

Record exact commands/manual cases, environment, observed result and remaining limits.
Distinguish unit/mocked checks from actual database/provider/browser journeys.

## Review

- [ ] Base branch is dev for normal work.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and relevant checks are complete.
- [ ] A teammate reviewed the change.
- [ ] Status/setup/traceability/design updated where affected.
- [ ] Remaining work is linked; source attribution is recorded and credentials are excluded.
